Archived 2026-08-26 for M3c; aanda.org (DataDome) and academic.oup.com (Cloudflare) are bot-walled, so these pages are the only offline source. Fetch enumeration was done by running the Python pipeline offline with a spying Fetcher (/tmp/m3c-baseline/run.py): 9 page GETs for aa39341-20 (DOI request + T1..T8 table sub-pages), 1 for 962260 (DOI request only; OUP tables are inline).
